legend.rule: field verified = >=2 independent source families agree (he.wikipedia + en.wikipedia = one family 'wiki'; tm, wf, ifa, rsssf, web sources separate). spells verified = a non-wiki source lists exactly the wiki seasons; verified-nonwiki = two non-wiki sources agree with each other but not with wiki; conflict = non-wiki source(s) disagree. Seasons are END years (2009/10 = 2010).
legend.aliasesNotNew: wiki-career names that are an existing DB player under another spelling - NOT new players.
legend.round4: adds national-football-teams club-season squads (born/pos/national team/seasons; spellsPartial = NFT seasons that are a strict subset of the wiki range) and Wikidata items of the player's own he.wiki article; current = matching data/clubs record now (null = not in DB); r3status = round-3 status.
legend.round3: Wikidata item (same he.wiki article, or Hebrew label + club-season tie) adds its own referenced claims and the TM/worldfootball/NFT/IFA records it links by id; r2status = round-2 status.
